| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Base contrast** `contrast` | 5 | 1.5 to 100 | The ratio between the brightest and the darkest base value after compression. |
| **Spatial sigma** `spatial` | 2 | 0.2 to 20 % | The spatial scale sigma_s of the bilateral filter, in percent of the longer side of the image. |
| **Range sigma** `range` | 0.4 | 0.05 to 2 | The range scale sigma_r of the bilateral filter, in log10 units of intensity. |
| **Downsampling** `downsample` | 4 | 1 to 16 | The bilateral filter runs on every z-th pixel in each direction, as in the paper. 1 runs it on every pixel. |
| **Linear light** `linearLight` | on | On or off | Decode the sRGB values to linear light first, so the intensity is proportional to light. |
